title: Five points: Magnus nearly lost world No. 1
post:
Magnus was 5 points from losing world No. 1 😳 Then he locked in 🔒 How far are you from 2800? 👇
Free, unlimited game reviews on Chessigma. Link in bio.
#ad #chessigma #chess #magnuscarlsen #caruana #lockin #goat

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen was five points away from losing number one.
phrases.say: [intense] Magnus Carlsen was five points away from losing number one.

phrases.text: Fifteen years at number one. He even posted: always locked in.
phrases.say: Fifteen years at number one. [pause] He even posted: [confident] always locked in.

phrases.text: Then came Budapest. Ten classical games. Zero wins.
phrases.say: Then came Budapest. [pause] Ten classical games. [pause] Zero wins.

phrases.text: And in one of them, with 46 seconds left, he walked straight into mate.
phrases.say: And in one of them, with forty-six seconds left, he walked straight into mate.

phrases.text: 22 points gone in five days. And Caruana was just five points behind.
phrases.say: Twenty-two points gone in five days. [pause] And Caruana was just five points behind.

phrases.text: The internet asked: is the Carlsen era over? And the comments begged: Magnus, lock in.
phrases.say: The internet asked: is the Carlsen era over? [pause] And the comments begged: [desperate] Magnus, lock in.

phrases.text: Then, a must-win game. A draw, and he drops under 2800 for the first time in 17 years.
phrases.say: Then, a must-win game. [pause] A draw, and he drops under twenty-eight hundred for the first time in seventeen years.

phrases.text: 46 seconds cost Magnus a game. Now his opponent had 37.
phrases.say: Forty-six seconds cost Magnus a game. [pause] Now his opponent had thirty-seven.

phrases.text: That's all Magnus needed. He locked in.
phrases.say: That's all Magnus needed. [pause] [intense] He locked in.

phrases.text: Still number one. Still the only player above 2800.
phrases.say: Still number one. [pause] Still the only player above twenty-eight hundred.

phrases.text: Top comment: when your lowest is their best. Literally.
phrases.say: Top comment: [pause] when your lowest... is their best. [pause] Literally.

phrases.text: One move almost cost Magnus his crown. Want to find the move that's costing you games?
phrases.say: One move almost cost Magnus his crown. [pause] Want to find the move that's costing you games?

phrases.text: Chessigma's game reviews are free and unlimited. On the App Store and Google Play. Link in bio.
phrases.say: Chessigma's game reviews are free and unlimited. On the App Store and Google Play. Link in bio.

phrases.text: So, how far are you from 2800?
phrases.say: So, how far are you from twenty-eight hundred?

_voice_notes: v3 (20.11.2026): the story was rewritten after the author's notes on draft 2 (rule 76): no GTA; the crown above the clouds, the lock-in meme, the mirror 46 s / 37 s, the top comment as the payoff. Numbers are spelled out in `say` (2800 = twenty-eight hundred).
